chars.HUSBAND: a man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers, a short black beard drawn on the chin
chars.WIFE: a woman wearing a teal hijab and a long burgundy djellaba
chars.SELLER: a woman about 45 wearing big gold hoop earrings, bright red lipstick, a tight leopard-print blouse and a black skirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a busy Moroccan vegetable souk, seen from just behind the wife's shoulder: the WIFE frowns suspiciously, arms crossed, staring at the SELLER, who stands mid-gesture behind her vegetable stall piled with tomatoes and peppers, smiling and waving flirtatiously. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of the SELLER behind her colourful vegetable stall in a Moroccan souk, posing with one hand on her hip and holding up a bunch of mint, winking playfully, dressed far too young for her age. Face visible, centred, calm souk background at the edges.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Walking out of the Moroccan souk carrying plastic bags of vegetables, the HUSBAND laughs and waves his hand dismissively to reassure the WIFE, who still looks back over her shoulder with doubt. Head-to-waist, both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan living room with a sedari sofa, the HUSBAND sits holding a ringing smartphone that lights up, looking at it with a curious raised eyebrow. A calendar on the wall. Face visible, centred.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The SELLER at her vegetable stall in the evening, holding a phone to her ear, twirling a strand of her headscarf-free look with a finger, smiling sweetly and talking in a soft seductive voice, small hearts implied by her dreamy expression. Face visible, centred.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND alone in a small Moroccan kitchen, holding his phone away from his ear and staring at the screen in surprise, mouth open, checking who is calling. Face visible, centred.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In front of a closed vegetable shop's metal door in a quiet Moroccan street at dusk, the SELLER waits dressed up in a fitted red evening dress with heavy makeup and gold jewellery, smiling at the HUSBAND, who has just arrived after work and stops in shock, holding his bag. Seen from beside the husband, both faces visible, head-to-waist, centred.
